Long Description: ’Ard Case: Add 2 to the bearer’s Toughness characteristic, but it no longer has the Firing Deck ability.

Short Description: 6" ALL Beast Snagga units re-roll Charges
Long Description: ’Ere We Go (Aura): While a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

Ammo Runt: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
